MALAYSIA ACT

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the Malaysia Act,
the Yang di-Pertuan Agong hereby makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Modification of Laws (Nurses
Registration) (Modification and Extension to East Malaysia) Order,

2. The Nurses Registration Ordinance, 1950 (hereinafter referred to as
the Ordinance) is modified in the manner set out in the Schedule.

3. The Ordinance as modified by Article 2 is extended to Sabah and
Sarawak.

4. Subsidiary legislation made under the Ordinance shall be applied
with such modifications as may be necessary to bring the same into
accord with the Ordinance as modified.
